message.jaymoskingdoms.story.reborn: The light lets go of you. What you were falls away; a new life begins.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.captive: The camp has found your cut ropes. Its raiders will hunt you until the day is out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.whalers: You've signed on %s as her harpooner. Stay aboard: she sails when she's fitted out, and every hand who comes home with her gets a share.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.making.real: The kingdoms of this land are rising. Your story begins in a moment...
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.timelost: This isn't your time. Only a Chrono's leap will take you home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.job: The village has work for a %s. Your tools are in your pack, and your work starts when you get there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.taken_in: %s takes you in as one of its own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.limb: You've lived without your %s for years.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.chained: The shackle holds you to the spot. Use a lockpick in hand on it, or sneak perfectly still after dark.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.rock_bottom: You have nothing, and you have not eaten in days.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.sentenced: The cell door is locked. Serve your days, use a lockpick on the door, or hold silver at it to pay the fine.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.evicted: You have no bed here. The watch does not let folk sleep rough in these streets after dark.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.hideout: The outlaws here count you one of their own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.cast_out: Your own kind will not hear you out, not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.heirloom: The blade is the best thing you own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.trader: Your mule stands at the milestone, its chest full.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.pup: The pup noses at your hand and will not leave your side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.nobodies: Three poor souls stand beside you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.lab: The air is thick, the door is open, and something metal is stirring behind you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.android: Your hands are cold, steady and not quite yours. The note in your pocket is crumpled from handling.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.moon_cursed: You are certain, with no reason, that you have been looked at.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.greenskin: The smoke of the camp is still in your clothes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.fated.title: Fate chose: %s
